_: Copy and structure of pricing.html, read by scripts/make-marketing-pages.mjs (which writes the committed HTML). `groups` maps EVERY plan-matrix.json feature row that any paid plan has to one comparison group; the table is built from plan-matrix.json at generation time, so a cell cannot say what the matrix does not, and `npm run test:marketing` fails when a row is in no group, in two groups, or a key here is not a matrix row. A key given as an array is ONE table row for matrix rows that are the same feature to a buyer (the import capability and the import module were two rows reading "Screenplay import" and "Import Screenplay"); the label is the first one's, and they must agree on every paid plan. Fields ending in Html are our own trusted markup (an em, a stamped span); everything else is escaped. No price, no plan name and no figure is typed here: those are stamped at build time from src/lib/plans.js and src/data/plan-matrix.json. No social proof of any kind. Keys ending in Usd are the same sentence for a visitor CHARGED in US dollars (usd_checkout on, docs/US-MARKET-PLAN.md): the page carries both and shows the rupee one until the server says dollars are charged.
